$comment: Copy to lab/<project-id>.json to give a project its own wing. Every field below is read by collector/classify.mjs and site/lab/scene.mjs; nothing else needs to change. A project with no file gets the Workshop wing: Build, Design and Research. match.cwd are basename globs of the checkout folders that belong to this project (worktrees included: 'myproject-*'). Each area: id (stable, lower-case), label (the sign over the bench), tint (a hex color for the area's floodlight strip), keywords (matched in a session's title and an agent's description, case-insensitive), paths (globs matched against the file paths in recent Read/Edit/Write tool inputs, relative to the checkout). Keep 3 to 9 areas, titled after the work done in this project: a wing needs at least 3 (fewer and the file is ignored; its sessions go to the Workshop), the floor is laid out in rows of three (a row fills before the next starts), and signage gets small past nine. fallback (optional): the area id a session matching nothing goes to; without it, the lobby.
label: My Project
